{{Disambig|Molten}}

==Modes==
'''Molten''' may refer to these gamemodes:
*[[Molten Mode]], one of the main Survival gamemodes.
==Enemies==
'''Molten''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Elite Molten]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 24 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Molten/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 14 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Boss]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 40 in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode
*[[Molten Demon]], an enemy summoned by the [[Molten Necromancer]]
*[[Molten Executioner]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 30 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Executioner/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Golem]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 16 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Golem/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Hazmat]], a [[PVP Test]] mid rank exclusive enemy that can only be sent after Wave 15
*[[Molten Hound]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 21 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Hound/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Mech]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Mech/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Necromancer]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Summoner]], a high health summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 31 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Molten Summoner/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Molten Titan]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 29 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
*[[Molten Titan (Legacy)]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 39 in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode
*[[Molten Warlord]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 35 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
